response.original_title: How Uncle Josh Defeated the Badgers
response.overview: An attractive young door-to-door saleslady uses her sensuality to sell Uncle Josh a new book and seals the deal by giving him a hearty kiss. At that moment, her co-conspirator enters with a camera, snaps a photograph, and sneaks back out. After the young lady leaves, the photographer knocks, shows Uncle Josh the compromising photo, and tries to extort money. Uncowed, Uncle Josh grabs the crook and hurls him headlong down a well, just as his wife, Aunt Jerusha, returns. She chastises Josh for his loose behavior.
response.title: How Uncle Josh Defeated the Badgers
